data.long_meaning: Netanelle is a Hebrew name meaning 'Given by God'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'Netat' which means 'given' and 'El' which means 'God'. In the Bible, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but it can be inferred from the name of the prophet Nathan who was given his name by God. The name Netanelle carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Netanelle usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Netanelle of Ossuary 3, a limestone box used for Jewish burial, was discovered in 1980 in the vicinity of Jerusalem. The inscription on the ossuary reads: 'Nathan-El of Netanelle'. This suggests that Netanelle was a common personal name during the Second Temple period (c. 516 BCE - 70 CE).
